target_object.description: The object type the goal sentence asks the agent to find: pan; kettle_or_teapot; dishsponge; other_kitchen_item (food, dishes, cups, mugs, utensils, cookware other than pans and kettles); office_or_bedroom_item (pens, books, CDs, phones, laptops, keys, cards, clocks, newspapers, pillows, remotes and similar); other for anything else; unknown if the goal is not visible.

task_type.description: All household goal categories recognized in the visible goal sentence. Categories such as heat_place already include picking and placement; do not add plain pick_place for those steps. Use an empty list if no category is recognized.
